title: Gazebo
question: Do isolated same-seed PPO runs produce identical checkpoints and evaluation curves?

paper.title: GzDRL: Reproducible and Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning with Gazebo
paper.locator: Section V-B, Figure 6, Table II: process-isolated same-seed and different-seed PPO reproducibility.

inputs.description: Author config: 5 same-seed runs with seed 42; different seeds {1,5,25,42,125}; eight environments; 500000 timesteps; checkpoints every 50000; 20 deterministic evaluation episodes.
inputs.access: Public code and bundled config; no private data indicated.

changes_from_author: Conda-forge portable native runtime, GCC15 rather than required11; disabled force-GCC11 CMake option.
Disambiguated22 scalar Spec<float> constructor bounds using explicit std::tuple<float,float> in bundled EnvPool headers. Patch preserved; no dynamics/task settings modified.

target.observable: Same-seed process-isolated PPO checkpoint hash identity and final return
target.reference: GzDRL Section V-B/Table II: 100% identical checkpoints and final return 18.43±0.00 with full author configuration
target.tolerance: Exact checkpoint hash equality; return tolerance unassigned until paper/code versions matched
target.tolerance_basis: Author same-seed determinism claim; do not silently equate a short pipeline test with full training
target.scope: Attempt author research artifact and preflight; full 500000-step configuration if native runner is feasible

execution.result: Completed all5full same-seed500000-requested-step training runs and1200evaluation episodes. Author preflight and independent12-checkpoint parameter identity checks pass; finalreturn16.53217 differs from paper18.43.

measurements.locator: SectionV-B, Figure6 and TableII same-seed row
measurements.interpretation: Same-seed determinism is supported by full author-code execution and independent parameter hashing. The published numerical final return is not reproduced; no tolerance is invented. Historical package/compiler lock is not established, and this portablebuild uses Gazebo10.6/GCC15 plus a mechanical constructor-disambiguation patch. Different-seed row was not run. Human scientific review pending.
